name: sonaiengine-graph-tool-call
description: When tool count exceeds LLM context limits, accuracy collapses (248 tools → 12%). graph-tool-call builds a tool graph from OpenAPI/MCP specs and retrieves multi-step workflows via hybrid search (BM25 + graph traversal + embedding), recovering accuracy to 82% with 79% fewer tokens. Zero dependencies. Also works as an MCP Proxy — aggregate multiple MCP servers behind 3 meta-tools.
